name: South Shore Place
summary: South Shore Place is a convenience-focused retail center in Braintree, MA, featuring quality service and retail tenants managed by the experienced Bierbrier Development team. The property serves the daily shopping needs of the local community with a strong mix of national retailers and professional on-site management.
demographics: South Shore Place attracts a diverse demographic mix from the greater Braintree area, serving middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes ranging from $75,000 to $110,000. The primary trade area draws families and working professionals aged 30-65 who value convenience-oriented shopping for everyday needs including groceries, pharmacy services, and quick-service dining. The center's location along Forbes Road positions it to capture both local residential traffic and commuters, with shoppers typically making frequent, short-duration visits for essential services and errands rather than destination shopping trips.
description: South Shore Place is a service and convenience retail destination located at 30 Forbes Road in Braintree, Massachusetts, developed and managed by Bierbrier Development. As part of Bierbrier Development's carefully curated portfolio of Eastern Massachusetts properties, South Shore Place exemplifies the company's 45-year commitment to creating vibrant retail centers that serve their communities with quality tenants and professional management. The center features a strong mix of national credit tenants including major pharmacy, grocery, and service-oriented retailers that cater to the daily needs of Braintree residents and surrounding communities. Bierbrier Development's deep understanding of local markets and established relationships with premier retailers ensure that South Shore Place maintains high occupancy with sought-after tenants. The property benefits from the company's hands-on management approach, responsive property maintenance, and commitment to creating comfortable shopping environments that add value to customers, merchants, and the community alike.
